description.p: CompositorLX is the native Qt Linux edition of Compositor. It edits layered images with masks, selections, adjustments, painting, transforms, filters, and non-destructive project storage.

Smooth painting on large pictures: brush, eraser, Clone Stamp, healing, blur, smudge and liquify strokes no longer copy the whole layer on every pointer move, and the canvas redraws only what the stroke changed, at full frame rate. Faster gradient drags. Tool shortcuts work after typing in a number field. A clearer eyedropper cursor and icon.

A cleaner look: slim sliders, flat fields, menus and buttons without outlines, smaller menu text without underlined letters, dialogs that open wide enough for their titles, sizes in whole pixels, and evenly stacked color swatches.

Sync with Compositor 1.7.6. Movie layers: import MOV and MP4 files, play or scrub them on the canvas, grab frames as stills, and relink moved movies (project format 23). Softer airbrush-style brushes at low hardness. A compact GIF timeline with a frame scrubber. Slimmer sliders, solid toolbar pills and clearer project tabs.
Closing the welcome panel leaves the area empty; File › New Canvas or the + tab button brings it back.
The welcome panel has a close button, and the recent projects on it show the three latest, each removable from the list.

Sync with Compositor 1.7.0. New filters Sharpen, Reduce Noise, Rim Light and Volumetric Light; Vignette, Lens Effects and Tonal Contrast as adjustment layers; editable shape fill, stroke and radius; Align and Distribute; custom crop ratios; layered PSD export; Distances; a pencil brush; project formats 18 to 22.

Sync with Compositor 1.5.8. New Filter › Lens Effects: anamorphic flare, starburst, mist, prism and shaped bokeh made from the picture's own light. GIFs play at their saved speed, and the delay shows the GIF's own milliseconds. RGB Split's blur smears both ways. Projects in format version 27 open.

Sync with Compositor 1.5.6. The GIF timeline has a large play button, a delay menu (Original or presets from 20 ms to 1 s) and numbered thumbnails whose right-click menu duplicates or deletes a frame. The Layers panel has a search field and a filter menu where several kinds of layer, or the selected layers, can be shown together. Canvas Size and Image Size keep the zoom and recenter the canvas.

Editable GIF layers, PDF import, RGB Split, channel packing, filter layers, pen pressure, styled lines, search, and PSD artboards. Refreshed with shared Vulkan rendering: accelerated filters and compositing that match the CPU, exports identical on every machine, compact GPU memory and tiling for large documents, an incremental canvas, asynchronous filter and Camera RAW previews, and a reworked Rendering panel.
